IMAGE-GNM soil denitrification and land-use leaching factors.

Source: R/datasets_balances.R
image_gnm_leaching_factors.Rd

The class factors of IMAGE-GNM's root-zone leaching fraction (Beusen et al. 2015, eq. 11, p. 4052), f_leach = [1 - min(f_climate + f_text + f_drain + f_soc, 1)] f_landuse, read by calculate_n_leaching() with method = "image_gnm": the denitrification fractions for soil texture (f_text), soil drainage (f_drain) and soil organic carbon content (f_soc) of Table 2 (p. 4053), and the land-use factor f_landuse (p. 4052). Table 2 is transcribed as printed. Its drainage column names five classes; the FAO classes it does not name, well drained and somewhat excessively drained, take 0 from the authors' model code, which books every well-drained class at 0. The organic-carbon classes are half-open, soc_min_pct <= SOC < soc_max_pct, as in the authors' class code; the table gives no numeric bound for its Organic class, which here starts where the 6-50\

Usage

image_gnm_leaching_factors

Format

A tibble with columns:

factor

Which factor the row gives: "texture", "drainage", "soc" or "land_use".

class

The class key calculate_n_leaching() matches: texture "coarse", "medium", "fine", "very_fine", "organic"; drainage "excessively_drained", "somewhat_excessively_drained", "well_drained", "moderately_well_drained", "imperfectly_drained", "poorly_drained", "very_poorly_drained"; organic carbon "below_1_pct", "1_to_3_pct", "3_to_6_pct", "6_to_50_pct", "organic"; land use "Cropland", "Grassland", "Natural".

label

The class as the source prints it (NA for the two drainage classes taken from the authors' code).

soc_min_pct, soc_max_pct

Bounds of an organic-carbon class, \ by weight (NA on other rows).

value

The factor (dimensionless).

source

Locator of the value.

Source

Beusen, A. H. W., Van Beek, L. P. H., Bouwman, A. F. et al. (2015). Coupling global models for hydrology and nutrient loading to simulate nitrogen and phosphorus retention in surface water - description of IMAGE-GNM and analysis of performance. Geosci. Model Dev. 8, 4045-4067. doi:10.5194/gmd-8-4045-2015 . Table 2 (p. 4053, after Van Drecht et al. 2003) for f_text, f_drain and f_soc; p. 4052 for f_landuse (1 for arable land, 0.36 for grassland and natural vegetation, citing Keuskamp, J. A., Van Drecht, G. & Bouwman, A. F. 2012, Environ. Pollut. 165, 67-76, doi:10.1016/j.envpol.2012.02.008 ). The well-drained and somewhat excessively drained classes: the authors' model code published with the paper, n_soil_denitrification.py (in N_model/trunk/tools/), fr_Ndenitrification_drainage(), lines 163-165.
